sections.heading: Usage
sections.text:
- Used to unlock rewards from the Season 1: KORD BREACH BattlePass.
- A total of 501 documents are required to complete the BattlePass in Season 1: KORD BREACH.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Can only be purchased in the Expansion Hub for TarCoins.
  - One is awarded for free upon account creation.
